verdict.rationale: Mastra exposes a well-documented programmatic API (createAgent, createTool, createWorkflow, streaming, memory) and even an MCP docs server so AI tools can read its API reference directly, which strongly supports AI-native, code-driven use. However, a direct probe for a public OpenAPI/REST spec (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 on all paths, so there is no confirmed standard machine-readable public API surface beyond the SDK/docs.
